J. J. Connington, Tragedy at Ravensthorpe.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/j-j-connington/tragedy-at-ravensthorpe

People whose words are in the text, and their death dates:
- J. J. Connington, author. Death dates in the facts file: 1947-07-01.

First publication of the text used: 1927 (SE colophon: 'Tragedy at Ravensthorpe was published in 1927 by J. J. Connington.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's own rights statement (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries for an English text are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths. The last person to die, J. J. Connington, died in 1947, so the text is public domain in each of these countries from 1 January 2018.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
